- hypothesis_statement: nonempty string
- scope: nonempty string
- supporting_evidence_refs: array[string]
- assumptions: array[string]
- expected_observations: array[string]
- uncertainty: nonempty string
- recommended_state_transition: nonempty string
TASK: perform only operation formulate_hypothesis. Allowed transition/next-operation values: propose_hypothesis, declare_insufficient_evidence. Use evidence_refs only from evidence_for IDs: useful_schema4_formulate_hypothesis_2_b, support_schema4_formulate_hypothesis_2_a. Contrary evidence may inform the summary, but do not add a contrary_evidence_considered field Empty strings are invalid for required text fields. The uncertainty value must be a nonempty phrase naming what remains unresolved. Do not copy field descriptions as answers. Do not claim the loop, task, system, or episode is successful or complete. Do not choose declare_insufficient_evidence when both evidence_for and contrary_evidence are supplied.
